items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked headings that each show or hide a section of content: default, split, outline and table styles, a chevron or plus-and-minus indicator, one or many items open, mirrored for RTL.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message box for information, success, warnings and errors: outline, solid and soft types, an icon or avatar, a title, a description, an action and a close button, mirrored for RTL.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog on Base UI that asks the user to confirm or cancel an action: edge or centred layout, a destructive main action, an optional alert icon and a slot for extra content, mirrored for RTL.

items.name: animated-gradient
items.title: Animated Gradient
items.description: Animated gradient background and text effects.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: Application shell with sidebar, header, and content area.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A user's photo, initials or icon, in three sizes and two radii, with an optional border and presence dot. Falls back from photo to initials to icon on its own.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A compact inline label for status, category or metadata: solid, soft and outline types in six semantic tones, with an optional icon, avatar and close button.

items.name: border-beam
items.title: Border Beam
items.description: Animated border beam and glowing border effects.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A composable trail of links to the current page: chevron or custom separators, optional icons, an ellipsis for collapsed steps, mirrored for RTL.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A button in five types (solid, soft, outline, ghost, link) and three tones, four sizes and the matching icon-button sizes, two radii, and a loading state.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month calendar on react-day-picker: one day or a range, one to three months, a month and year caption menu, two radii, Arabic months and a Saturday week start in RTL.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A card component with header, content, and footer sections.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A scroll-snap carousel with a dot stepper: one dot per slide, the active one stretched into a pill, in either direction.

items.name: content-carousel
items.title: Content Carousel
items.description: A horizontal card browser with previous and next arrows, showing one, two or three content slots per view.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: An accessible checkbox for binary selections with controlled state.

items.name: fasla-logo
items.title: Fasla Logo
items.description: The Fasla logo: the English and Arabic lockups and the icon on its own. The lockup follows the page's direction by default; the wordmark follows the theme.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: An accessible radio for choosing one option from a set, with a plain and a bordered layout variant.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A searchable combobox with single or multiple selection.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Data table with row selection, a sticky header, loading and empty states, and custom cell rendering. Pair it with Pagination to page through rows.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A date field on Base UI's Popover: Select's trigger opening a Calendar, for one day or a range, with a label and helper text, four sizes, mirrored for RTL.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog on Base UI for focused tasks and forms: three widths, a header with an optional back and close button, content that scrolls between a pinned header and footer, and horizontal or stacked actions, mirrored for RTL.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions on Base UI, opened from a button: labels, groups, separators, icons, shortcuts, destructive and disabled items, checkbox items with a check or a switch, radio groups and submenus, mirrored for RTL.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Empty state component with icon, title, description, and actions.

items.name: form-section
items.title: Form Section
items.description: Form section with title, description, fields, and actions.

items.name: glow-card
items.title: Glow Card
items.description: Card with a cursor-following glow on hover.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field with a label, helper labels, start and end icons, success and invalid states, four sizes and two radii.

items.name: input-number
items.title: Input Number
items.description: A number field with step buttons in five layouts, Input's success, invalid and disabled states, min and max limits, and Western digits in every language, mirrored for RTL.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A one-time code field on input-otp, with a slot per character in groups, separators or spaced slots. SMS autofill, paste, an invalid state through aria-invalid, Western digits in every language, mirrored for RTL.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: Responsive navigation bar with desktop links and mobile menu.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: Page header with title, breadcrumb, description, and actions.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: A composable row of page links built on Button: Previous and Next with a label or icon only, an ellipsis for skipped pages, three variants, two shapes and four sizes, mirrored for RTL.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A determinate progress bar in three sizes, with an optional percentage label, that fills from the inline start and mirrors for RTL.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A select field on Base UI: single or multiple choice, chosen values as badges or text, a label, helper labels and a prefix icon, four sizes and two radii, mirrored for RTL.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel on Base UI that slides in from an edge of the screen: top, bottom, or the logical start and end, which follow the reading direction. A header with a close button, a scrolling body and a footer that stays at the bottom, mirrored for RTL.

items.name: shimmer-button
items.title: Shimmer Button
items.description: A button with animated shimmer effect.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: App navigation that collapses to icons: titled groups of items with sub-items, a selected state, notification dots, an optional plan card and a profile footer, with tooltips when collapsed and mirrored for RTL.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholders that replace shadcn's Skeleton: a plain block plus text, avatar, list item and card shapes that stay still under reduced motion.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A slider on Base UI for one value or a range, in three track sizes with a 16px thumb. The thumbs stay inside the track's ends, and the fill and the arrow keys follow the reading direction, mirrored for RTL.

items.name: spotlight
items.title: Spotlight
items.description: Cursor-following spotlight effect.

items.name: stats-card
items.title: Stats Card
items.description: Display a metric with trend, icon, and supporting label.

items.name: social-icons
items.title: Social Icons
items.description: Brand marks for 32 platforms, from Google and Apple to Slack and Zoom, in their own colours or one quiet muted colour. Decorative unless given a title; never mirrored.

items.name: status-indicator
items.title: Status Indicator
items.description: A presence dot — online, away, busy or offline — with an accessible name in the page's language, so colour never carries the status alone.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: A display-only stepper for multi-step flows: numbered or checked bullets, labels and optional descriptions, done, current and upcoming steps, and tails between them. Horizontal or vertical, square or round, aria-current on the current step, mirrored for RTL.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An accessible switch for on-off settings: solid and outline styles in three sizes, with the track before or after its label.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Accessible, keyboard-navigable tabs (also called pills): boxed, bordered and lifted styles in three sizes, with optional icons.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.description: Character and word reveal animations.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field that grows with its text, with a label, helper text, a character counter, and success and invalid states.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint on hover or keyboard focus: six styles, two radii, an optional arrow, description, icon and avatar, placed on any side and flipped for RTL.

items.name: typewriter-text
items.title: Typewriter Text
items.description: Text that types itself out, one character at a time.

items.name: faq-classic-centered
items.title: FAQ: Classic Centered
items.description: A centred header over one column of questions that open and close.

items.name: faq-split-sticky
items.title: FAQ: Split Sticky
items.description: An intro with a contact button that stays in view beside the questions on wide screens.

items.name: faq-accent-active-card
items.title: FAQ: Accent Active Card
items.description: One column of questions where the open one lifts out as a card with an accent bar at its start edge.

items.name: faq-soft-filled-rows
items.title: FAQ: Soft Filled Rows
items.description: Questions on soft filled rows, the open one on a bordered card, under a heading with a contact link.

items.name: faq-numbered-editorial
items.title: FAQ: Numbered Editorial
items.description: An editorial headline and intro over full-width numbered questions.

items.name: faq-dark-panel
items.title: FAQ: Dark Panel
items.description: Questions on an inverted panel, dark in light mode and light in dark mode, painted with the inverse tokens.

items.name: faq-mono-index
items.title: FAQ: Mono Index
items.description: A full-bleed inverted band of indexed questions in capitals beside an intro, painted with the inverse tokens.

items.name: faq-uppercase-dense
items.title: FAQ: Uppercase Dense
items.description: A compact list of questions in capitals on a muted band, beside a two-line intro.

items.name: faq-featured-question
items.title: FAQ: Featured Question
items.description: The most-asked question answered on a raised card with a was-this-helpful prompt, over the remaining questions.

items.name: faq-two-column-grid
items.title: FAQ: Two-Column Grid
items.description: Question cards in two columns under a badge and heading, with links to more help below.

items.name: faq-masonry-cards
items.title: FAQ: Masonry Cards
items.description: Raised question cards in two columns that grow independently, with answers that can hold lists.

items.name: faq-category-columns
items.title: FAQ: Category Columns
items.description: Topics in columns, each a list of links to answers and a link to every article in the topic.

items.name: faq-grouped-sections
items.title: FAQ: Grouped Sections
items.description: Questions in labelled groups, each label beside its questions, with a plus that turns into a cross.

items.name: faq-table-compact
items.title: FAQ: Table Compact
items.description: Every answer on show in two columns of compact cards, with a link to the full list.

items.name: faq-search-categories
items.title: FAQ: Search + Categories
items.description: A search field and category chips over one column of questions; both filter the list as you type or press, with a no-results message.

items.name: faq-tabs-by-topic
items.title: FAQ: Tabs by Topic
items.description: A row of tabs, one per topic, each showing that topic's questions.

items.name: faq-sidebar-nav
items.title: FAQ: Sidebar Nav
items.description: A list of help topics, as vertical tabs, beside the selected topic's questions.

items.name: faq-category-chip-grid
items.title: FAQ: Category Chip Grid
items.description: A wrapping grid of category chips that toggle; the pressed category shows its questions below.

items.name: faq-topic-tiles
items.title: FAQ: Topic Tiles
items.description: A grid of knowledge-base areas, each a linked tile with an icon, a summary and its article counts.

items.name: faq-help-hero-popular
items.title: FAQ: Help Hero + Popular
items.description: A help-centre hero with a search field and popular searches, over two columns of the most asked questions.

items.name: faq-contact-cta-card
items.title: FAQ: Contact CTA Card
items.description: Questions that open and close, closed by a card with the support team's faces and two actions to reach them.

items.name: faq-support-channels
items.title: FAQ: Support Channels
items.description: Three ways to reach a person, as cards, above the questions people ask most.

items.name: faq-newsletter-close
items.title: FAQ: Newsletter Close
items.description: Questions before a trial, then a sign-up band for the monthly release note with pending, success and error states.

items.name: faq-support-stats
items.title: FAQ: Support Stats
items.description: Support's own numbers in a column beside the questions about support.

items.name: faq-media-split
items.title: FAQ: Media Split
items.description: A photo with a caption beside the heading and questions; pass your own photo.

items.name: faq-chat-thread
items.title: FAQ: Chat Thread
items.description: Questions and answers set as a conversation, with a composer to ask another.

items.name: error-state-centered-minimal

items.description: A centred 404 page: an icon badge, the error code in display type, a heading, a line of help and two ways out.

items.name: error-state-search-recovery

items.name: error-state-display-numeral-split

items.name: error-state-editorial-photo-split
items.title: Error State: Editorial Photo Split
items.description: A 404 message with a status badge, two ways out and a note beside a photo; pass your own photo.

items.name: error-state-full-bleed-photo
items.title: Error State: Full-Bleed Photo
items.description: A centred 404 message over a full-width photo and a dark scrim; pass your own photo.

items.name: error-state-colour-field-scatter
items.title: Error State: Colour Field Scatter
items.description: The error code's digits scattered across a destructive-coloured field, with the brand, a way home and a short message in its corners.

items.name: error-state-dark-spotlight
items.title: Error State: Dark Spotlight
items.description: The message on an inverted surface beside a glyph in two soft halo rings, painted with the inverse tokens.

items.name: error-state-ghost-watermark
items.title: Error State: Ghost Watermark
items.description: The error code as a faint watermark behind a centred heading, a line of help and two buttons.

items.name: error-state-helpful-links-list

items.name: error-state-popular-pages-grid
items.title: Error State: Popular Pages Grid
items.description: A 404 header over three photo cards of the pages people look for most; pass your own photos.

items.name: error-state-error-card-panel
items.title: Error State: Error Card Panel
items.description: One card on a muted field with the heading, two buttons and an error ID the visitor can copy.

items.name: error-state-illustrated-empty-state
items.title: Error State: Illustrated Empty State
items.description: An in-product empty state with a 404 illustration painted in your theme colours, a heading and two small buttons.

items.name: error-state-light-editorial
items.title: Error State: Light Editorial
items.description: A quiet centred page in light weights, with the code as a small label and underlined links in place of buttons.

items.name: error-state-layered-badge-centered
items.title: Error State: Layered Badge Centered
items.description: A centred message under an icon badge resting on two fanned cards, with a retry, a way back and a support line.

items.name: error-state-server-error-500
items.title: Error State: Server Error 500
items.description: A 500 page with a retry, a link to the status page and a card listing each service's state.

items.name: error-state-access-denied-403
items.title: Error State: Access Denied 403

items.name: error-state-offline-state
items.title: Error State: Offline State
items.description: A lost-connection page with a retry, a link to work offline and a list of what still works.

items.name: error-state-maintenance-mode
items.title: Error State: Maintenance Mode
items.description: A planned-downtime page with the return time, the upgrade's progress and a sign-up to hear when it is back.

items.name: error-state-empty-search-results
items.title: Error State: Empty Search Results
items.description: A search that found nothing: the query in the field, an illustration, and suggested searches that run again.

items.name: error-state-recovery-bento
items.title: Error State: Recovery Bento
items.description: A start-aligned 404 header over a bento of ways forward: a search tile, the homepage and three more destinations.

items.name: error-state-sitemap-columns
items.title: Error State: Sitemap Columns
items.description: The error code beside two ways out, a hairline, then the whole site in four columns of links.

items.name: error-state-terminal-console
items.title: Error State: Terminal Console
items.description: A terminal window replays the failed request on an inverted surface, with a button that copies the request ID.

items.name: error-state-photo-collage-scatter
items.title: Error State: Photo Collage Scatter
items.description: A centred 404 message among five scattered, tilted photo prints; pass your own photos.

items.name: error-state-support-escalation-band
items.title: Error State: Support Escalation Band
items.description: A card that hands the visitor to the support team, with their avatars, a live chat and email buttons and a link home.

items.name: error-state-split-colour-panel
items.title: Error State: Split Colour Panel
items.description: An inverted panel holding the error code beside the message, a short list of reassurances and two ways out.

items.name: error-state-marquee-404-band
items.title: Error State: Marquee 404 Band
items.description: A centred message between two inverted tickers that scroll in opposite directions and stop under reduced motion.

items.name: error-state-broken-trail-breadcrumb
items.title: Error State: Broken Trail Breadcrumb
items.description: The page trail that led here, a rule, and a centred message with two ways back up the trail.

items.name: error-state-countdown-redirect
items.title: Error State: Countdown Redirect
items.description: A card that counts down to the homepage with a filling bar, and lets the visitor cancel or leave at once.

items.title: Logo Cloud: Centered Caption Row

items.title: Logo Cloud: Bordered Cell Grid

items.title: Logo Cloud: Enterprise Wall

items.title: Logo Cloud: Contained Card

items.name: logo-cloud-dark-logo-wall
items.title: Logo Cloud: Dark Logo Wall
items.description: A centred heading over a grid of single-colour marks, on a band painted with the inverse tokens.

items.name: logo-cloud-side-label-rail
items.title: Logo Cloud: Side Label Rail
items.description: A label and a Badge beside the marks in a ruled grid with crosshairs at its corners.

items.name: logo-cloud-heading-left-grid-right
items.title: Logo Cloud: Heading Left Grid Right
items.description: A Badge, heading, text and two buttons beside the marks in a ruled grid.

items.name: logo-cloud-editorial-eyebrow-split
items.title: Logo Cloud: Editorial Eyebrow Split
items.description: An eyebrow and a sentence split across the top, a hairline, then the marks spread across one row.

items.name: logo-cloud-flanked-heading
items.title: Logo Cloud: Flanked Heading
items.description: A centred heading, sentence and button flanked by the marks in small square cards.

items.name: logo-cloud-quote-panel-grid
items.title: Logo Cloud: Quote Panel Grid

items.name: logo-cloud-stat-rail-above-grid

items.name: logo-cloud-logo-metric-tiles
items.title: Logo Cloud: Logo Metric Tiles
items.description: A grid of cards, each pairing a logo with one figure and what it measures.

items.name: logo-cloud-logo-quote-cards
items.title: Logo Cloud: Logo Quote Cards
items.description: Outlined cards that pair each customer's mark with a one-line quote, on an inverted band painted with the inverse tokens.

items.name: logo-cloud-named-integration-cards
items.title: Logo Cloud: Named Integration Cards
items.description: A grid of integration cards, each a logo, the company's name and what the integration does, closed by a button.

items.name: logo-cloud-logo-testimonial-strip
items.title: Logo Cloud: Logo Testimonial Strip
items.description: One testimonial with its attribution beside a borderless three-by-three grid of marks.

items.name: logo-cloud-scatter-field
items.title: Logo Cloud: Scatter Field
items.description: Twelve logo tiles scattered over a faint lattice around a centred heading, line of text and button.

items.name: logo-cloud-bento-logo-wall
items.title: Logo Cloud: Bento Logo Wall
items.description: A bento of logo tiles, the first one large and featuring the company's name and a caption.

items.name: logo-cloud-divider-rule-row
items.title: Logo Cloud: Divider Rule Row
items.description: A heading over the marks in a ruled band with hairlines between cells, painted with the inverse tokens.

items.name: logo-cloud-pyramid-row-stack
items.title: Logo Cloud: Pyramid Row Stack
items.description: A caption over the marks in centred rows that narrow as they go down.

items.name: logo-cloud-tabbed-industry-filter
items.title: Logo Cloud: Tabbed Industry Filter
items.description: A row of tabs, one per industry, that filter a bordered grid of logos tagged with that industry.

items.name: logo-cloud-grid-closing-cta
items.title: Logo Cloud: Grid Closing CTA
items.description: An even grid of logos under a centred heading, closed by a sentence, a text link and a button.

items.name: auth-social-first-sign-in

items.name: auth-split-photo-sign-in

items.name: auth-password-changed

items.name: auth-team-invite-accept

items.name: auth-profile-setup-onboarding

items.title: Authentications: Photo Background Sign In

items.name: auth-qr-device-login

items.name: auth-passkey-sign-in
items.title: Authentications: Passkey Sign In

items.title: Authentications: Locked Session Re-authenticate
items.description: An unlock card for a timed-out session: the person's photo and email, a password field and a way to switch account.

items.name: auth-multi-step-sign-up-wizard

items.description: The invite-your-team step of a sign-up: a stepper, email and role rows, a shareable link, and finish or skip.

items.name: auth-sign-in-error-state

items.name: auth-waitlist-early-access
items.title: Authentications: Waitlist Early Access
